prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE N5 school vocabulary stimulus. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, symbols, watermark or collage. Make the exact spatial/possession/content relation visually unambiguous. Medium: friendly flat 2D educational drawing, no 3D. Exact target PLAT + AMB + ARBRE. One ordinary shallow dinner plate containing one living tree with trunk, branches and leafy crown. Whimsical natural tree, not bonsai pot, toy, food or printed plate motif. Only plate and tree with essential tiny root patch, no landscape, people or extra contents. Broad white margins.
